intent.summary: Harden auto supervision per user rulings 2026-10-30: (1) dirty-snapshot guard — the loop passes the pre-spawn dirty-file baseline into the spawn env and in-spawn stage commits exclude those paths with a loud warning, so a runner session can never sweep the supervisor's uncommitted edits into an advance commit (live incident: VERIFY advance swept a half-written cli.cjs); (2) async spawn execution — replace the synchronous spawn runner with an event-loop-alive child process so run-lock heartbeats fire during spawn waits and the idle timeout kills a stalled stream live instead of classifying after the fact (also cures status being blocked by a stale-heartbeat concurrency guard and its dangerous break-lock advice against a live runner)
